value.syntax: # [doc = " Output arguments for the checker modes in (´sec:clicommon:output-roles-and-stamps´)."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " A checker runs in one of two modes:"] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " - **direct** — no `--report`/`--stamp`: the JSON result goes to"] # [doc = "   stdout (refused on a terminal) and no stamp is touched;"] # [doc = " - **build** — both `--report` and `--stamp`: the result is published"] # [doc = "   as an explicit report asset (compare-if-changed), the stamp is"] # [doc = "   touched only after a successful report write, and stdout stays"] # [doc = "   empty."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " `clap` enforces the reciprocal requirement, so a lone `--report` or"] # [doc = " `--stamp` is a usage error before the command runs."] # [derive (clap :: Args , Debug)] pub struct CheckOutputArgs { # [doc = " Build mode: write the JSON result to this explicit report file."] # [arg (long , value_name = "FILE" , requires = "stamp")] pub report : Option < std :: path :: PathBuf > , # [doc = " Build mode: touch this success stamp after publishing the report."] # [arg (long , value_name = "FILE" , requires = "report")] pub stamp : Option < std :: path :: PathBuf > , }
